snippet.title: A.A.U. Trailer #2
snippet.description:
The mission has collapsed — and now there’s no turning back. A.A.U. Trailer #2 delivers a deeper look into the fast, brutal action‑horror experience inside the abandoned territory of Uzovnica. Tension rises, threats escalate, and the truth behind the operation grows even darker.

As an agent of the covert special forces unit A.A.U., you were deployed to Serbia on a classified assignment. But the moment you carried out your orders, everything changed.
Framed. Intercepted. Cut off from extraction.
Now you’re trapped inside Uzovnica — alone, hunted, and surrounded by a reality that refuses to behave as it should.
